goal: Players open their own worlds, find other people's without any central service, link them with portals and walk between them; missing mods download on the way; identity and achievements live on Chia. The game in those worlds: survival in the Valheim spirit with real temperatures and seasons, and animals to tame, breed and raise, from real facts.

pieces.name: Engine
pieces.what: Weft, the voxel engine we forked: world, rendering, interface, modding. We change it only where our goals need it.
